task: Audit and fix Action Done Matrix (Form RU-F-033) print pagination leak where table rows and borders leak below the footer on page breaks, clipping text and rendering orphaned fragments

rootCause.absoluteFooterPrintContract: In ActionDoneMatrixTab.jsx, @media print styled .adm-document-footer with `position: absolute !important; bottom: 8mm !important;`. This pulled the footer out of normal layout calculation. When a table row was large or exceeded page bounds, table borders and cell text continued flowing into the 8mm bottom margin behind/below the footer, while the footer top border sliced through the table row like a guillotine.
rootCause.monolithicRowOverflow: All recommendations for a panel member were consolidated into a single monolithic row. A panelist with 9 detailed recommendations occupied ~41.5 lines of text. When pushed to a continuation sheet with a ~30 line capacity, dumping the row as an indivisible unit forced page overflow.
rootCause.missingContinuationSplitting: The system lacked bullet-aware row splitting to partition multi-bullet recommendations across sheet boundaries.

solutionApplied: Replaced `position: absolute !important; bottom: 8mm !important;` with in-flow flex layout: `position: relative !important; bottom: auto !important; margin-top: auto !important; flex-shrink: 0 !important; width: 100% !important; width: calc(210mm - 36mm) !important;` in @media print (matching SecretaryMinutesDocumentSheet.jsx:1506).

Wrapped all page content above the footer inside `.adm-page-content-wrapper` with `flex: 1 1 auto !important; min-height: 0 !important; display: flex !important; flex-direction: column !important;`, guaranteeing it is physically impossible for table cells or borders to leak below or collide with the footer.

Implemented `extractSuggestionItems` and `splitADMRowIfOversized(row, maxLines)` to automatically split oversized multi-bullet rows into head and continuation chunks, allocating leading items to the current sheet and remaining items to a continuation sheet under `${panelName} (Continued)` with `isContinuation: true`.

Recalibrated row height estimation weights for BukSU 8.5pt font (Col 2: 38 chars/line, Col 3: 32 chars/line, Col 1: 24 chars/line) and page capacities (Page 1: 22 lines, Continuation: 30 lines, Final: 10 lines).
Synchronized continuation row mutation handlers (handleCellChange, handleCellBlur, handleToggleFulfillment, handleDeleteRow) to resolve base row ID via `rowId.split('__cont_')[0]`.

verificationProof.zeroFooterLeakEvidence: Playwright print audit (scratch/audit_adm_with_9_bullets.mjs) verified: leaksBelowFooter: false, gapBetweenTableAndFooterPx: 607px, Any content leaking below footer: false.
